newsitem.title: CHINA: U.S. insurance firm AIA moves home in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: U.S. insurance firm AIA moves home in Shanghai.

text.p: The American International Assurance Company (AIA) will soon move back to its former headquarters on Shanghai's waterfront, a company statement said on Thursday.

AIA, a wholly owned subsidiary of American International Group, on Thursday signed a 30-year contract to rent out the eight-storey building, constructed in 1921 as the North China Herald Building, it said.

The Neo-Renaissance style building, to be renamed the AIA Building, has total floor space of over 9,000 square metres. It was home to the headquarters of AIA after it was set up in Shanghai in 1931 until the Communist take-over in 1949.
AIA reopened its Shanghai branch in 1992, the first foreign insurance company allowed to do both life and non-life insurance business in China since 1949.
